design: Four excluded full warmups, then balanced Williams orders; every configuration occupies every position equally, and pairwise order is balanced. No trimming, retries or result-cache samples.

environment.memory_metric: Windows Job Object PeakJobMemoryUsed: process-tree committed memory; includes auxiliary console hosts; not Linux cgroup file-cache accounting

input_sealing: All selected application and dependency paths and bytes are rediscovered before and after each command. Vendor is a private sealed copy, not an ACL-read-only mount.
load_limit: Host load, CPU frequency, antivirus and OS file-cache state are uncontrolled and recorded where observable.
capacity_guard: Before each timed command, at least4GiB physical and commit headroom must remain available for10seconds. Only the owned analyzer tree is aborted if either headroom drops below512MiB; such an observation is invalid, never a fallback timing.
diagnostics: All fields and duplicate occurrences are compared to that configuration's excluded Windows warmup; no rule-set equivalence or cross-OS DTO identity is assumed.

native_measurement_controls.first_control_fixture_repairs: An initial control assumed exactly two processes; native observation revealed Windows console hosts. Final controls verify both exact Python identities and account for the observed console hosts. No analyzer timing was collected during those fixture-repair controls.

failed_series_before_capacity_guard.failure: VirtualAlloc 0x5af, worker disconnect and native fallback during system commit exhaustion
failed_series_before_capacity_guard.exclusion_from_summary: The first series is incomplete and has one failed observation; the fresh complete series uses a new capacity precondition. Every old valid observation remains here; none is silently trimmed or resumed.

limits: Windows Job Object committed memory and Linux cgroup memory including file cache are different metrics.

The 584 selected source/config inputs match the Linux project. Runtime binaries, OS PHP extensions, generated Composer maps and physical CPU placement differ; cross-OS timing is not a controlled OS-only experiment.
Rule sets differ; Larastan L5 retains seven configuration ignores, while L10 clears them. No universal PHPStan-level equivalence is claimed.
All diagnostic fields and duplicate occurrences are verified within each Windows configuration; matching the Linux diagnostic count does not establish cross-OS DTO identity.
N=4 on a shared loaded host; CPU frequency, antivirus and OS file cache are not controlled. Every valid observation is retained.

Analyzer source is the previously validated published commit. The new measurement helper has real native controls; the 502-command Composer suite is not repeated for documentation and benchmark-only changes.
The initial incomplete series is retained in full. Its global commit limit and capacity differed from the guarded complete series; its fallback observation is not a successful Laramago timing.

The mutable original project acquired13 frontend/build changes during the run. All584 selected PHP/config inputs and original vendor paths/bytes still match, while the measured isolated copy stayed entirely sealed. The wrapper live-origin postcheck failed and is preserved separately; it is not presented as a passed check.
Cleanup and Windows benchmark changes are local and uncommitted. Hosted CI is NOTRUN for this task.
